messages:
anya: quick heads-up — on staging I saw a weird token shift when using the new chat template + kv-cache. minimal repro: system msg + user msg -> generation returns an extra leading <|eos|> token sometimes. anyone seen this?

mike: hmm saw something similar last week but thought it was weights mismatch. which model/weights path?

anya: rn testing model-v3-quant on dedicated. weights in gs://redwood-weights/model-v3/2026-03-10/. tokenizer config is the chatfmt one (chat_role_delims: true).

rohan: can you paste the exact input you used? easier to repro.

anya: sure —
```json
{"messages":[{"role":"system","content":"You are a helpful assistant."},{"role":"user","content":"Summarize the following text."}]}
```
output token ids (snippet): `[50256, 13, 345, 50257, ...]` — see 50256 is our <|bos|> sentinel, 50257 is <|eos|>. sometimes we get an extra 50257 before user content which shifts decoding.

tess: could be chatfmt glue adding an extra sentinel during prompt assembly. do you assemble with the tokenizer.encode + join or using serializer helper?

anya: using helper `chat.serialize_for_model()` (python), which previously worked for model-v2. added a small change to always append eos at end of system role.

mike: that change sounds suspicious. if serializer appends eos for system and the runtime also injects eos for role boundaries we double up. caching + prefix KV might also rehydrate the EOS into KV cache.

rohan: @anya can you run the tokenizer smoke check?

anya: running now: `./tools/tokenizer-check --weights gs://redwood-weights/model-v3 --chatfmt --sample 10`

infra-bot: job 9214 queued on infra-runner-3. logs @ https://ci.redwood/infrastructure/9214

mike: while that runs — quick workaround: disable serializer-eos flag and rely on runtime role delimiters. we should also add a lint that verifies prompt->token sequence doesn't contain consecutive sentinel tokens.

tess: agreed. also add a regression test that covers kv-cache rehydration + partial prompt caching. I can add a unit in prompt-assembly tests.

anya: infra job finished. outputs look like: first tokens: `[..., 50256, 50257, 13, ...]` — yep consecutive BOS(50256) + EOS(50257) before user content on several samples.

rohan: ok that nails it. can someone file a tiny patch: 1) revert serializer auto-eos, 2) add lint to tools/tokenizer-check to fail on adjacent special tokens, 3) add a unit test for cached prefix decoding. I can take (3).

mike: taking (1). will push a PR shortly and tag for quick review.

tess: I'll add the lint (2) — plan: detect sequences where token in SPECIALS followed by any other SPECIAL within 3 tokens and flag as warning/fail depending on env.

anya: thanks all. FYI, customer sandbox QA hit a different symptom where trailing eos got dropped on long system messages — probably related. will open an incident note after PRs.

mike: PR: https://git.redwood/eng/tokenizer/merge_requests/210 — changeset reverts serializer eos append. cc @tess @rohan for tests/lint.

rohan: ack, pulling PR now. quick review then merge if tests green.

tess: lint PR: https://git.redwood/eng/tools/merge_requests/54 — added check + opt-in env flag `TOKENIZER_STRICT=true` for CI.

anya: once merged I'll run a quick smoke on dedicated and promote to staging. if all good we'll schedule a canary for weekend low-traffic window.

mike: sounds good. note to ops: if canary fails we should auto-fallback to model-v2 for the affected route.

infra-bot: canary window scheduled: 2026-03-21 02:00 UTC -> 03:00 UTC. rollback policy: immediate if p50 latency > 250ms or error rate > 0.5%.

anya: perfect — thanks everyone, will post results in this thread after deploy. :thumbsup:
